research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Focal Systems is advancing retail automation through deep learning computer vision. Their research includes an out-of-stock detection system that captures shelf images to notify management of stock levels, using bounding boxes for product labels. They also develop an operating system for retail stores that applies AI to detect stock conditions and recommend actions. Additionally, they work on a portable checkout unit that generates training data for automatic checkout systems, enhancing inventory management and customer experience. These efforts focus on optimizing retail operations and improving inventory visibility.

about_short_description.short_description: Focal Systems is a retail automation platform that automates and optimizes retail through the use of deep learning computer vision.

product.name: FocalOS
product.description: An AI-based operating system for brick-and-mortar retail that combines real-time store visibility with automated task management, replenishment prioritization, and operational decision support.

product.name: Shelf AI
product.description: An AI-powered shelf monitoring platform that uses camera images to identify product availability, stock gaps, planogram issues, and replenishment needs across retail stores.

product.name: Computer Vision
product.description: A retail computer-vision system that captures and analyzes aisle-level images to provide real-time visibility into products, shelves, top stock, and back stock.

product.name: Action Tool
product.description: A task-management and execution tool that converts shelf and store insights into prioritized, assigned workflows for replenishment, ordering, merchandising, labor, and ecommerce fulfillment.

product.name: Impact
product.description: A management dashboard for measuring the operational and financial effects of retail computer vision, including labor redeployment, reduced out-of-stock duration, completed tasks, compliance, and sales recovery.

product.name: Retail Availability Solutions
product.description: Solutions that use real-time shelf monitoring and automated replenishment workflows to detect stock gaps, reduce out-of-stocks, and improve on-shelf product availability.
